treasures.name: fallen leaf
treasures.desc: A red-and-yellow leaf as big as a blanket. It crackles when you touch it.

treasures.name: twig
treasures.desc: A thin, crooked twig that snapped off the hedge. Just your size for a walking stick, or for poking things.

treasures.name: seed packet
treasures.desc: A torn paper packet with a few seeds left. The picture shows a blue flower.

treasures.name: glass bead
treasures.desc: A red glass bead. If you look through the hole, it's like a telescope.

treasures.desc: A piece of web. You got it yourself!

friends.name: Tock
friends.impression: Tock is smart but sometimes talks too fast. I like helping him with his paperclip.

friends.name: Mrs. Bristle
friends.impression: Mrs. Bristle is grumpy but knows where things are. She helped me find the red button.

friends.name: Old Gorse
friends.impression: Old Gorse is mean and doesn't care about lily pads. He only likes fox tracks.

friends.name: Pip
friends.impression: Pip is nice and likes to build things with me. We planted a seed together.

friends.name: Crumb
friends.impression: Crumb is careful with beads. He warned me about the coin in the pond.

diary.text: I found a shiny silver hoop and thought it was a treasure! And then I looked at frogspawn and saw tiny movements inside the eggs. The pond was COLD and foggy, and I couldn’t find a twig. Why won’t the phone tell me where the cat is? I’m sleepy and my toes are numb. My teapot feels like home, but I wish I had a blanket.

I found a twig! It was all pointy and brown. I kept it in my teapot. It's my treasure! A spider spun a web round and round. I watched it for a long time. It was so fast! Mrs. Bristle gave me new clothes! Acorn-cap hat, mossy jumper, leaf raincoat, walnut boots, felt coat, dandelion scarf, thistledown mittens. I wore the mossy jumper and leaf raincoat. They were WARM and COZY! I tried to build tools with frost and screws. But they broke. I tried again. They broke again. I'm too cold and tired. My legs are cross with me. Why won't the tools work? Maybe the frost is too slippery. Time to go home. I'm sleepy. I'll dream about the spider's web and my twig treasure.

Mrs. Bristle found me and I slept in my glove bed. I wore my felt coat and dandelion scarf. I drew the treasure shelf with a leaf and twig. The fog was COLD and I saw the giants' windowsill. Why do the seeds rain down from the poppy? I need to rest now.

dream.text: The dug-up spot had glowing eyes and whispered my name. I ran to the teapot but the hedge twisted into a snake and hissed. Mrs. Bristle held my paw and the pond showed my face huge and screaming.

diary.text: Whoa! I DREAMED the dug-up spot had glowing eyes and whispered my name. And then the hedge turned into a SNAKE and hissed. Mrs. Bristle held my paw and the pond showed my face HUGE and screaming. I ate raspberries to stay warm but my toes were still COLD. I tried making a net with web and twig but it BROKE. Why did the pond show me screaming? I’m tired and my legs are cross with me. I just sat there and ate raspberry stash.

I drew the hedge with a smooth stone for Tock. I found a seed packet and a glass bead. I made a frend named Pip! My acorn-cap hat is COOL. The sky is GREY and COLD. I drew a pretend frend with a thimble hat. Why is the sun hiding? I’m lonely but I’m CURIOUS.
